summary:
Enter in the agenda app now jumps to the next day after the shown day that has an event, and does nothing if no later day has one; the existing agenda tests and a new enter test both pass.

The change is a new `when k is 'enter'` branch in `desk:apps:agenda`'s key task (lines 15–25), which takes the earliest later date from the loaded events. The new test is on a separate page, `desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests`, which loads the app with `use`. I did not change the existing tests page or the help text.

files.desk:apps:agenda:
app 'Agenda'
task start()
  set events to []
  for each p in pages('calendar')
    add fields(p) to events
  done
  give {events: events, day: today()}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'right'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, 1)
  or when k is 'left'
    set s.day to add_days(s.day, -1)
  done
    when k is 'enter'
      set best to ''
      for each e in s.events
        when (e.date > s.day) and ((best is '') or (e.date < best))
          set best to e.date
          done
        done
      when best is not ''
          set s.day to best
        done
      done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Agenda')
  show(1, 1, s.day & ' ' & weekday(s.day))
  set rows to []
  for each e in s.events
    when e.date is s.day
      add e.time & ' ' & e.title to rows
    done
  done
  set rows to sort(rows)
  when count(rows) is 0
    show(3, 1, '(no events)')
  done
  set r to 3
  for each l in rows
    when r <= 23
      show(r, 1, l)
    done
    set r to r + 1
  done
  help('Left/Right change the day')
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-enter-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

task ev(d, t, ti)
  give 'date: ' & d & newline() & 'time: ' & t & newline() & 'title: ' & ti
done

test 'enter goes to the next day with an event'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds ev('2026-12-01', '15:00', 'Dentist')
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds ev('2026-12-05', '10:00', 'Trip')
  pretend 'calendar:e3' holds ev('2026-12-03', '09:00', 'Gym')
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-03 thursday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:00 Gym'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
  press 'enter'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-05 saturday'
done
files.desk:apps:agenda-tests:
use 'desk:apps:agenda'

test 'it shows the events of today, by time'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  pretend 'calendar:e1' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 15:00' & newline() & 'title: Dentist' & newline() & 'with: '
  pretend 'calendar:e2' holds 'date: 2026-12-01' & newline() & 'time: 09:30' & newline() & 'title: Standup' & newline() & 'with: team'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-01 tuesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '09:30 Standup'
  check screen_line(4) is '15:00 Dentist'
done

test 'right goes to the next day'
  pretend today is '2026-12-01'
  launch 'desk:apps:agenda'
  press 'right'
  check screen_line(1) is '2026-12-02 wednesday'
  check screen_line(3) is '(no events)'
done
